generated.what_happened: A new eight-episode television series based on "Crazy Rich Asians" is coming to HBO, serving as a sequel that picks up events after the hit 2018 film. Original cast members Constance Wu, Henry Golding, Michelle Yeoh, and Ronny Chieng are set to reprise their roles. Adele Lim, who co-wrote the original movie, will serve as showrunner and executive producer alongside the film's director, Jon M. Chu. Based on Kevin Kwan's bestselling books, the new series will delve deeper into the franchise's characters and worlds.
